units.title: Validate and save a note
units.goal: Persist one validated note and return its identity.
outputs: A durable note identity or validation error
acceptance: A valid title and body produce one saved note and identity.
A blank title returns a validation error and creates no record.

units.title: List saved notes
units.goal: Return saved note titles and identities without mutation.
outputs: A collection of saved titles and identities
acceptance: A saved note appears with its original title and identity.
An empty store returns an empty collection and is unchanged.
